title: Dominica’s coconut rough cake
hookLine: Global-inspired dominica’s coconut rough cake with 12 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Sift & Whisk Dry Ingredients
steps.instructionTemplate: Mix all dry ingredients in bowl Add coconut milk to dry ingredients. Sifting aerates the dry ingredients and removes any stubborn cocoa or flour lumps so the finished crumb bakes up light and even. Incorporate {m53571_1}, {m53571_2}, {m53571_3}, and {m53571_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure wheat flour first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Cream Butter & Sugar Fluffy
steps.instructionTemplate: Grease baking pan with vegetable oil I use an ice cream scoop to form drops. I placed the scooped cake mixture on a baking sheet. I also used a cake mold and gently pressed the mixture in. You can use a baking pan as well. Incorporate {m53571_5}, {m53571_6}, {m53571_7}, {m53571_8}, {m53571_9}, {m53571_10}, {m53571_11}, and {m53571_12} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Bake Dominica’s coconut rough cake & Check Doneness
steps.instructionTemplate: Bake for 30 minutes until the edges turn golden and set while the center remains tender. Test with a toothpick—if it comes out with a few moist crumbs rather than wet batter, it is ready.

steps.title: Preheat & Prep Your Pan
steps.instructionTemplate: Preheat your over at 350° Bake for 25 to 35 minutes or until brown. Let Dominica’s coconut rough cake cool for 10–15 minutes so the crumb sets cleanly before slicing into 6 portions, then garnish and serve.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Wait until the sponge feels cool to the touch before frosting so your glaze or cream stays thick and glossy.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 45 mins!
